page.overview:
What is Moon of Staggec delegation?

A delegation from the Moon of Staggec was offered by Wookiee Senator Yarua a valuable item in return for their alliance. Yarua and Senator Padmé Amidala were captured by Confederacy of Independent Systems forces before they could make the exchange with the delegation.
